who.value: internal team (design, PM, engineering) working on Taiwan's Live launch

job.value: See every touchpoint that changes for TW Live and open its prototype

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Taiwan Live launch' with the intro and the 'Touchpoints' table (TW today / SG today / TW launch) makes the purpose clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: Nine prototype chips, three outlined buttons and three filter chips all compete with similar weight.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Open the flow map' and the prototype chips are clear, but 'All owners / Entry & Live / Recommerce' don't read as owner filters until tried.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Flag names like 'LIVE_STREAM_ENABLED', 'enableCarousellLiveShowDiscovery' and 'Lumos CMS' are unexplained for designers and PMs.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The only choice is which prototype or filter to open.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Code paths and flag names sit inline in every 'TW launch' cell instead of behind a detail toggle.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything is about this launch's change list.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: A three-line intro paragraph and multi-sentence table cells must be read to get anything out of the page.
